Metadata.title: GoMechanic
Metadata.description: Car and bike service and repairs at Mukai Chowk, Kiwale, Pune. AC, brakes, tyres, batteries and more, priced before work starts. Book on WhatsApp or call.

HomePage.title: Car and bike service in Kiwale, Pune

hero.lead: Servicing and repairs for cars and two-wheelers, at our garage on Mukai Chowk.

story.title: How a visit works
story.lead: Four steps, from your first message to collecting your vehicle.

book.title: Book on WhatsApp or call
book.text: Tell us your vehicle and what it needs, and we'll agree a time.

visit.title: Bring it to Mukai Chowk
visit.text: Drive or ride to our garage in Kiwale during opening hours.

check.title: We check it and tell you the price
check.text: A mechanic looks at your vehicle and tells you what it needs and what it costs, before any work starts.

collect.title: Collect it and pay at the garage
collect.text: We let you know when it's ready. You pay at the garage when you collect it.

services.title: What we work on
services.lead: From a routine service to repairs after an accident.

Contact.bookingMessage: Hi, I'd like to book a service for my vehicle.

Login.heading: Log in
Login.intro: Log in with your mobile number. We'll send you a 6-digit code by SMS.
Login.consentLabel: I agree that {brand} can use my mobile number to log me in and to contact me by SMS, WhatsApp or phone about my bookings.
Login.notice: We keep your mobile number and when you agreed. We use it only to log you in and to tell you about your bookings. To stop this or delete your data, call the garage.
Login.alreadySentTo: We already sent a code to {number}. It works for 5 minutes.
Login.resendReady: You can ask for a new code now.
Login.help: Trouble logging in? Call us on <call>{phone}</call>.
Login.noScript: Logging in needs JavaScript. You can still call us on <call>{phone}</call> to book.

errors.tooSoon: Please wait a few seconds before asking for another code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many codes for this number. Try again after {time}, or call us.
errors.rateLimitedLater: Too many codes for this number. Try again on {date} after {time}, or call us.
errors.invalidCode: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.
errors.wrongCode: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Check the latest SMS, or ask for a new code.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.startOver: This login has expired. Enter your number again.
errors.connection: We couldn't reach the garage's server. Check your connection and try again.

Sms.loginCode: {code} is your {brand} login code. It works for {minutes} minutes. Don't share it with anyone.

Account.heading: Your account
Account.nameNote: We use your name to greet you and to know whose vehicle is whose at the garage.

nameErrors.name-invalid: Use letters, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens only.

MyVehicles.empty: You haven't added a vehicle yet.
MyVehicles.formNote: We use these details to book and service your vehicle. The dates are optional.
MyVehicles.registrationHint: As on the number plate, like MH 12 AB 1234 or 22 BH 1234 AB.
MyVehicles.notListed: Don't see your vehicle? Call us or message us on WhatsApp, and we'll help.
MyVehicles.noCatalogue: Adding a vehicle here isn't available right now. Call us or message us on WhatsApp, and we'll add it for you.

errors.vehicle-missing: Choose your vehicle's type, brand, model and fuel.
errors.vehicle-unknown-model: We can't take bookings for that model here. Choose another, or call us.
errors.vehicle-fuel-not-offered: That model doesn't come with this fuel. Choose its fuel again.
errors.registration-unknown-state: The first two letters aren't a state code. Check the number on the plate.
errors.registration-invalid: Enter a number like MH 12 AB 1234 or 22 BH 1234 AB. If your plate looks different, call us and we'll add your vehicle.
errors.registration-duplicate: You've already added a vehicle with this number.
errors.date-out-of-range: Enter a date from 2000 up to 10 years from today.
